purpose: Convert the M107 paper stock/option allocations into pre-execution readiness classifications and paper ticket drafts without touching account, margin, portfolio, positions, or order submission.

readiness_meaning.ready: Mechanical paper ticket is within policy and does not require the human-review flags used in this layer. In M108 this applies to stock-long tickets only.
readiness_meaning.needs_human_review: Mechanical paper ticket is within hard policy limits but requires review before any later execution layer. This includes short stock and option spreads with assignment/exercise risk.
readiness_meaning.not_ready: Paper ticket draft exists but failed a hard readiness check. In this run all not-ready cases failed minimum live reward-to-risk.
readiness_meaning.not_candidate: The source allocation was blocked before the execution readiness layer.

ticket_draft_types.stock: Paper stock ticket draft with BUY or SELL_SHORT action. SELL_SHORT requires borrow, margin, and account review in a future layer.
ticket_draft_types.option_combo_debit_spread: Paper option combo ticket draft with BUY_COMBO action, NET_DEBIT_LIMIT order type, long/short legs, estimated live max loss, estimated live max profit, and slippage-buffered limit debit.

interpretation.status: M108 is a pre-execution readiness layer, not an execution layer.
interpretation.finding: M107 produced 279 selected paper allocations. M108 can draft tickets for all 279, but only 247 pass hard readiness checks or require human review; 32 option spreads are blocked by live reward-to-risk below 0.20.
interpretation.recommendation: Before any live order-routing work, add account/margin/position sizing, borrow availability, option exercise/assignment risk approval, and explicit human approval gates.
